entries.text: Sometimes you want people to READ what you wrote, not edit it. Switch the access mode to "Anyone can view" and the share link lets visitors open the doc but not change it, no caret, no toolbar actions, no AI prompt bar. The doc still syncs in real time, so if you keep editing they see the latest version.

entries.caption: Open the share dialog from the lock icon
The share dialog opens, four access modes below the link.
Pick "Anyone can view", anyone with the link can read the doc but not change it.

entries.text: A visitor opens the link in their own browser. The document opens read-only: no caret, no formatting toolbar, no AI prompt bar: and markoto refuses any change from them on the server too, not just in the interface. They can read; they can't change.

entries.caption: The visitor lands in the doc, but the editor is read-only. No caret blink, no formatting toolbar, no AI prompt bar. The lock icon in the topbar reflects the view-only mode.
